rules: Arrange leading, label and trailing in that order inside container. label is required and non-empty; it is the visible text and is read as plain text, so the meaning never depends on the color: the intent only reinforces what the words say.
intent names the status family: neutral for a category or a state without valence (Draft, Archived), info, success, warning and danger for the matching statuses.

The subtle appearance paints container in surface with a border of borderWidth in border inside its boundary, label and trailing content in content and the leading icon in iconColor. The strong appearance paints container in strongSurfaceColor without a visible border, and label and the leading icon in strongContentColor.

The label is set in typography (the indicator typography of the size, one step below a Button label of the same size), on one line, never wrapped; when the available width is shorter than the badge, the label is truncated with an ellipsis, leading and trailing stay whole, and the full label stays available as text to assistive technology.

The container block size is the line box of the label typography plus paddingBlock above and below; the label is centered vertically on its capital height, not on the line box. Inline padding is paddingInline on both sides, the minimum inline size equals the block size, and corners use radius.

The leading part holds at most one decorative icon at iconSize, hidden from assistive technology and placed by its drawing: icons of the reference set draw 1/8 of iconSize inside their box, so the icon box overlaps the padding by that amount. slotGap separates it from the label.

The trailing part holds at most one Counter, slotGap after the label, at the badge size and in the badge content color (its tint follows); the inline padding on the trailing side is then paddingBlock, so that the counter sits in an even rim. The counter is read after the label (Bugs 12); its own label, when set, gives the number its meaning. Trailing content is allowed with the subtle appearance only: on a strong surface the counter tint lowers its digits below 4.5:1.
Sizes are named like Button sizes; the typography and the icon size do not change with density, the paddings do.

The badge is not interactive: it is never focusable, emits no events and has no hover, pressed or disabled state. It does not change the colors of the surrounding content and is not placed inside a Button slot (a quantity in a Button is a Counter).
In forced-colors mode the container shows an edge of borderWidth in the system text color and the label stays in the system text color, so the box stays visible in both appearances.
